home.lead: Full-stack developer. I build web and mobile products end to end, from the first conversation with a client to the deploy.
home.routeLabel: Based in La Plata, Argentina (UTC−3), working remotely with teams anywhere.

about.title: About
about.p1: I've been building for the web since 2022: React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js and Java on the back end, and React Native when the product needs to live on a phone.
about.p2: I like owning a feature from requirements to production, and I'm most at home on logistics problems: shipments, tracking, getting things where they need to go. Day to day I work with Claude Code to move faster on new features and legacy code alike.
about.p3: Outside work I play video games, try out new tools, and work out to balance all the hours at a desk.

fts.summary: Built a shareable web app that tracks shipments from warehouse to depot, maintained a large legacy app for internal and external users, and designed the server and database work that keeps its data current.

vinculum.summary: Built core web app features that lifted user engagement by 15%, gathered requirements directly with clients, designed database structures and APIs, and shipped with zero-downtime deploys.

devlabs.summary: Shipped mobile and web features that raised user retention by 10%, and cut the critical error rate by 20% by debugging the app's API calls.
